questions.stem: Calculate hepatic clearance of a drug with hepatic blood flow of 2000 ml/min and hepatic extraction ratio of 0.5. What is the hepatic blood flow extraction ratio?
questions.solutionHtml:
1000ml per min
  • Hepatic clearance = hepatic blood flow X hepatic extraction ratio

              = 2000 x 0.5

              =1000ml/min



Katzung, Basic & Clinical Pharmacology, 12th Edition, Page Number: 43

questions.stem: A patient comes 6 hours after consuming morphine and presents with pinpoint pupils and respiratory depression. T ½ is 3 hours and the Volume of distribution is 200L. The plasma Concentration is 0.5 microgram/ml. Calculate the initial loading dose of the morphine.
questions.solutionHtml:
400 mg
  • Vd = 200L
  • T ½ = 3 hours
  • Plasma concentration after 6 hrs = 0.5 microgram/ml
  • T ½ = 3 hours, So Plasma concentration before 3 hrs = 1 microgram/ml
  • T ½ = 3 hours,
  • So Plasma concentration at the time of consumption = 2 microgram/ml
    • = 2mg/L
  • So, applying the formula
  • Loading dose = Vd x plasma concentration ( at time of consumption of morphine)
  • = 200 x 2
    = 400 mg


Goodman & Gillman's, The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 13th Edition. Page No.: 28
